invariants: Default TestExecutor and normal runner behavior are unchanged.
No private-field reflection in the implemented schema ownership decision.
Preserve eager source validation, declared XSD-version policy, modules, environment expressions, missing files and uncertain or incomplete namespace mappings.
No unconditional bypass option is included in the actual harness; unsafe controls stay in the isolated prototype only.
